question: Which of the following is the time period of the Sixth five year plan?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1980-1985**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Sixth Five Year Plan in India took place from 1980 to 1985: 
 
• The plan was led by Prime Minister Indira Gandhi and aimed to: Reduce poverty, Increase employment, Achieve rapid industrialization, and Become technologically self-reliant. 
 
• The Sixth Five Year Plan marked the beginning of economic liberalization in India.
 
• This included the elimination of price controls and the closure of ration shops, which led to higher food prices and an increase in the cost of living.
